result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock left. In your example, WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10".

The change is one extra condition, `AND s.quantity > 0`, in the query behind the list, `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The single-product quantity lookup is a separate query that I didn't touch, so asking for nuts in WH-1 should still answer 0.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='Stock*Test'` and it passed with no output. I didn't add a test for the zero-quantity case, and I didn't run the full suite.
